Shop My Account Getting Here Back to Visit Arrival Pinkney Park is located at 177 Rowayton Avenue in Rowayton, CT.
The park is open to Shakespeare on the Sound audience members starting three hours before showtime, at 4pm.
When you enter the park, please make your way to the Box Office located near the entrance of the park.
​ ​ Parking The Old School Field on Witch Ln is the closest and best parking option and is located down the street from Pinkney Park - however, space is limited, so be sure to arrive early!
Overflow parking is available at the U nited Church of Rowayton.
There is a municipal parking lot in Rowayton and on street parking down Rowayton Avenue.
There is handicap parking available in Pinkney Park.
Please contact our office at (203) 957-1006 to secure an accessible parking space.
Getting Here by Train The Rowayton Train Station is located about a half a mile from the park, an Uber or Lyft can easily drop you off right at the entrance.
